qe: If in a certain code language DEAL is written as 4-5-1-12, then how LADY will be written in the same code language?
qh: यदि किसी कूट भाषा में DEAL को 4-5-1-12 लिखा जाता है, तो उसी कूट भाषा में LADY को कैसे लिखा जाएगा?
e:
Method 1 (Direct Positional Value Shortcut):
Step 1: 'DEAL' me har letter ki standard alphabetical position direct likhi gayi hai:
- D = 4, E = 5, A = 1, L = 12 → 4-5-1-12.
Step 2: 'LADY' ke har letter ki standard position likhein:
- L = 12
- A = 1
- D = 4
- Y = 25
Code banega: 12-1-4-25.
Correct '12-4-1-25'2-1-4-25 hai.

Method 2 (Option Elimination Method):
- L = 12 hone se '10-1-4-23' eliminate ho gaya.
- Second letter A = 1 hona chahiye, '12-4-1-25' me '4' diya hai jo galat hai.
- Last letter Y = 25 hota hai, '12-1-4-22' me '22' diya hai. Keval '12-1-4-25' sahi hai.
Sahi uttar '12-1-4-25' hai.

Exam point: code bhasha ka pattern - ise yaad rakhein; isi tarah ke prashn pariksha mein doharaaye jaate hain.

qe: In a certain code language, ACNE is written as 3-7-29-11, then how BOIL will be written in the same code language?
qh: किसी कूट भाषा में ACNE को 3-7-29-11 लिखा जाता है, तो उसी कूट भाषा में BOIL को कैसे लिखा जाएगा?
e:
Method 1 ((2 × Position + 1) Shortcut Method):
Step 1: 'ACNE' me transformation rule dekhein: $\text{Code} = (2 \times \text{Position}) + 1$.
- A(1) → $(1 \times 2) + 1 = 3$
- C(3) → $(3 \times 2) + 1 = 7$
- N(14) → $(14 \times 2) + 1 = 29$
- E(5) → $(5 \times 2) + 1 = 11$
Step 2: 'BOIL' par same formula apply karein:
- B(2) → $(2 \times 2) + 1 = 5$
- O(15) → $(15 \times 2) + 1 = 31$
- I(9) → $(9 \times 2) + 1 = 19$
- L(12) → $(12 \times 2) + 1 = 25$
Code banega: 5-31-19-25.
Correct option  5-31-19-25 hai.

Method 2 (First Letter Elimination Method):
B(2) ke liye code $(2 \times 2) + 1 = 5$ hoga. Chaaron options me se sirf '5-31-19-25' '5' se shuru ho raha hai, baaki sab bina check kiye eliminate ho jate hain.
Sahi uttar '5-31-19-25' hai.

Exam point: code bhasha ka pattern - ise yaad rakhein; isi tarah ke prashn pariksha mein doharaaye jaate hain.

qe: If in a certain code language, MACHINE is written as 19-7-9-14-15-20-11, then how DANGER will be written in the same code language?

e:
Method 1 (Position + 6 Shortcut Method):
Step 1: 'MACHINE' me har letter me +6 joda gaya hai: $\text{Code} = \text{Position} + 6$.
- M(13) + 6 = 19
- A(1) + 6 = 7
- C(3) + 6 = 9
- H(8) + 6 = 14
- I(9) + 6 = 15
- N(14) + 6 = 20
- E(5) + 6 = 11
Step 2: 'DANGER' par +6 apply karein:
- D(4) + 6 = 10
- A(1) + 6 = 7
- N(14) + 6 = 20
- G(7) + 6 = 13
- E(5) + 6 = 11
- R(18) + 6 = 24
Code banega: 10-7-20-13-11-24.
Correct '11-7-20-16-11-24'0-7-20-13-11-24 hai.

Method 2 (First Letter Elimination Trick):
D(4) + 6 = 10. options '11-7-20-16-11-24' and '13-7-20-9-11-25', aur (D) me pehla number 11 ya 13 diya hai jo galat hai. Keval '10-7-20-13-11-24' 10 se shuru hota hai.
Sahi uttar '10-7-20-13-11-24' hai.

qe: If in a certain code language, WORK is written as 4-12-9-16, then how DONE will be written in the same code language?
qh: यदि किसी कूट भाषा में WORK को 4-12-9-16 लिखा जाता है, तो उसी कूट भाषा में DONE को कैसे लिखा जाएगा?
e:
Method 1 (Opposite Positional Value Shortcut):
Step 1: 'WORK' me har letter ke opposite letter ki position likhi gayi hai ($27 - \text{Position}$):
- W ↔ D = 4 ($27 - 23$)
- O ↔ L = 12 ($27 - 15$)
- R ↔ I = 9 ($27 - 18$)
- K ↔ P = 16 ($27 - 11$)
Step 2: 'DONE' ke opposite letters ki values likhein:
- D ↔ W = 23
- O ↔ L = 12
- N ↔ M = 13
- E ↔ V = 22
Code banega: 23-12-13-22.
Correct '12-13-22-23'3-12-13-22 hai.

Method 2 (Option Elimination by 2nd & 3rd Letter):
- D ka opposite W = 23 (Options B aur C eliminate).
- O ka opposite L = 12 hona chahiye, '23-13-12-22' me second number 13 diya hai jo galat hai. Keval '23-12-13-22' bachta hai.
Sahi uttar '23-12-13-22' hai.

Exam point: kaam aur samay ka sootra - ise yaad rakhein; isi tarah ke prashn pariksha mein doharaaye jaate hain.

qe: If in a certain code language, WORK is written as 5-6-9-2, then how LOVE will be written in the same language?
qh: यदि किसी कूट भाषा में WORK को 5-6-9-2 लिखा जाता है, तो उसी भाषा में LOVE को कैसे लिखा जाएगा?
e:
Method 1 (Digit Sum of Position Shortcut):
Step 1: 'WORK' ke letters ki positions ke ankon ko joda gaya hai (Digital Root / Sum of Digits):
- W(23) → $2 + 3 = 5$
- O(15) → $1 + 5 = 6$
- R(18) → $1 + 8 = 9$
- K(11) → $1 + 1 = 2$
Step 2: 'LOVE' par same digit sum rule lagayein:
- L(12) → $1 + 2 = 3$
- O(15) → $1 + 5 = 6$
- V(22) → $2 + 2 = 4$
- E(5) → 5
Code banega: 3-6-4-5.
Correct '3-5-7-8'-6-4-5 hai.

Method 2 (First Letter Elimination Method):
L(12) ke ankon ka yog $1 + 2 = 3$ hoga. Isliye '2' aur '1' se shuru hone wale options '2-4-5-6' and '1-2-3-4' eliminate ho gaye. O(15) ka yog $1 + 5 = 6$ hoga, '3-5-7-8' me 5 diya hai jo galat hai. Keval '3-6-4-5' sahi hai.
Sahi uttar '3-6-4-5' hai.

Exam point: kaam aur samay ka sootra - ise yaad rakhein; isi tarah ke prashn pariksha mein doharaaye jaate hain.

qe: If in a certain code language, KDJQ is written as 8-1-4-2, then how PRMT will be written in the same language?
qh: यदि किसी कूट भाषा में KDJQ को 8-1-4-2 लिखा जाता है, तो उसी भाषा में PRMT को कैसे लिखा जाएगा?
e:
Method 1 (Reverse Digit Sum Shortcut):
Step 1: 'KDJQ' me positions ka digit sum nikal kar reverse order me likha gaya hai:
- Q(17) → $1 + 7 = 8$ [Last se 1st]
- J(10) → $1 + 0 = 1$ [3rd se 2nd]
- D(4) → 4 [2nd se 3rd]
- K(11) → $1 + 1 = 2$ [1st se Last]
Code bana: 8-1-4-2.
Step 2: 'PRMT' par reverse order me digit sum lagayein:
- T(20) → $2 + 0 = 2$ [1st number]
- M(13) → $1 + 3 = 4$ [2nd number]
- R(18) → $1 + 8 = 9$ [3rd number]
- P(16) → $1 + 6 = 7$ [4th number]
Code banega: 2-4-9-7.
Correct '2-4-9-7'-4-9-7 hai.

Method 2 (First Number Elimination Trick):
Aakhiri letter T(20) ka digit sum $2 + 0 = 2$ sabse aage aayega. options '3-4-9-7' and '4-3-9-7', aur (D) me pehla number 3 ya 4 hai, jo seedhe eliminate ho jate hain. Keval '2-4-9-7' '2' se shuru ho raha hai.
Sahi uttar '2-4-9-7' hai.

Exam point: code bhasha ka pattern - ise yaad rakhein; isi tarah ke prashn pariksha mein doharaaye jaate hain.

qe: If in a certain code language, REQUEST is written as S2R52TU, then how ACID will be written in the same code language?
qh: यदि किसी कूट भाषा में REQUEST को S2R52TU लिखा जाता है, तो उसी कूट भाषा में ACID को कैसे लिखा जाएगा?
e:
Method 1 (Vowel Numbering & Consonant +1 Shortcut):
Step 1: Rule samjhein:
- Vowels ko unke serial number ke roop me likha gaya hai: A = 1, E = 2, I = 3, O = 4, U = 5.
- Consonants me +1 jod kar agla letter likha gaya hai.
Step 2: 'REQUEST' me dekhein:
- R(+1) = S, E = 2, Q(+1) = R, U = 5, E = 2, S(+1) = T, T(+1) = U → S2R52TU.
Step 3: 'ACID' par apply karein:
- A (Vowel 1) → 1
- C (Consonant) → C + 1 = D
- I (Vowel 3) → 3
- D (Consonant) → D + 1 = E
Code: 1D3E.
Correct '1394'D3E hai.

Method 2 (First & Last Character Elimination):
- Pehla letter 'A' ek vowel hai jiska code '1' hoga, isliye options 'IC94' and 'B3J4' eliminate ho gaye.
- Aakhiri letter 'D' consonant hai jo D + 1 = 'E' banega, jabki '1394' me pure numbers (1394) hain. Keval '1D3E' bachta hai.
Sahi uttar '1D3E' hai.

Exam point: rasayan ke niyam - ise yaad rakhein; isi tarah ke prashn pariksha mein doharaaye jaate hain.

qe: If MANAGER = 34, DIRECTOR = 35 and ASSISTANT = 36, then how STAFF will be written in the code language?
qh: यदि MANAGER = 34, DIRECTOR = 35 और ASSISTANT = 36 है, तो कूट भाषा में STAFF को कैसे लिखा जाएगा?
e:
Method 1 (Vowel Count & Consonant Count Shortcut):
Step 1: Code ka do-digit structure dekhein:
- Pehla digit = Word me Vowels ki sankhya
- Doosra digit = Word me Consonants ki sankhya
Step 2: Verification karein:
- 'MANAGER': 3 Vowels (A, A, E), 4 Consonants (M, N, G, R) → 34.
- 'DIRECTOR': 3 Vowels (I, E, O), 5 Consonants (D, R, C, T, R) → 35.
- 'ASSISTANT': 3 Vowels (A, I, A), 6 Consonants (S, S, S, T, N, T) → 36.
Step 3: 'STAFF' me count karein:
- Vowels = 1 ('A')
- Consonants = 4 ('S', 'T', 'F', 'F')
Code: 14.
Correct '14'4 hai.

Method 2 (Direct Inspection Method):
Word 'STAFF' me kewal 1 vowel hai, isliye code anivarya roop se '1' se shuru hona chahiye. Vikalpon me kewal '14' '1' se shuru hota hai.
Sahi uttar '14' hai.

Exam point: code bhasha ka pattern - ise yaad rakhein; isi tarah ke prashn pariksha mein doharaaye jaate hain.

qe: If AT = 20 and BAT = 40, then how CAT will be written in the code language?
qh: यदि AT = 20 और BAT = 40 है, तो कूट भाषा में CAT को कैसे लिखा जाएगा?
e:
Method 1 (Positional Value Product Shortcut):
Step 1: Letters ki alphabetical positions ka guna (multiplication) kiya gaya hai:
- 'AT': A(1) × T(20) = 20
- 'BAT': B(2) × A(1) × T(20) = 40
Step 2: 'CAT' par apply karein:
- C = 3, A = 1, T = 20
$$\text{Product} = 3 $\times$ 1 $\times$ 20 = 60$$
Correct option  60 hai.

Method 2 (Proportional Multiplier Method):
'AT' ka man 20 hai. 'BAT' me extra 'B' (man = 2) aane par $20 \times 2 = 40$ bana. 'CAT' me extra 'C' (man = 3) hai, isliye $20 \times 3 = 60$ hoga.
Sahi uttar '60' hai.

Exam point: code bhasha ka pattern - ise yaad rakhein; isi tarah ke prashn pariksha mein doharaaye jaate hain.

  - E(5) - 3 = 2
  - E(5) - 3 = 2

  - I(9) - 3 = 6
  - G(7) - 3 = 4

- H(8) - 3 = 5
- E(5) - 3 = 2
- E(5) - 3 = 2
- L(12) - 3 = 9
Combined Code: 5229.

H(8) - 3 = 5. Chaaron vikalpon me se kewal '5229' '5' se shuru ho raha hai, baaki sabhi vikalp turant eliminate ho jate hain.
